title: Treaty of Saint-Germain-en-Laye (1679)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Saint-Germain-en-Laye (1679)", at revision 1378813910, opens: "The Treaty or Peace of Saint-Germain-en-Laye of 19 June (OS) or 29 June (NS) 1679 was a peace treaty between France and the Electorate of Brandenburg. It restored to France's ally Sweden her dominions Bremen-Verden and Swedish Pomerania, lost to Brandenburg in the Scanian War. Sweden ratified the treaty on 28 July 1679." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q551302, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1679 peace treaty". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
